events.headline: Stock Market Today, Sept. 24: BlackBerry Lifts Fiscal 2027 Guidance on Record QNX Revenue
BlackBerry Jumps 4% as Record QNX Revenue Lifts Full-Year Outlook; Mobileye and Aptiv Dip

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Q2 FY2027 beat with 26% revenue growth; raised full-year revenue and EPS guidance for the second time this year on QNX momentum and major new design wins.
providers.risk: Execution on large royalty contracts and software growth sustainability.

providers.reason: BlackBerry delivered a 'Rule of 50' quarter on September 24, with 26% revenue growth and 29% adjusted EBITDA margins. The QNX segment achieved record revenue and its highest margins ever. Growth is further underpinned by a major $100 million royalty backlog addition from its largest-ever design win with the Daimler-Volvo joint venture.
providers.risk: The stock's dependence on the automotive sector means macro-driven production delays could impact the timing of royalty realization.

providers.reason: Q2 FY2027 earnings reported Sept 24 showed 26% YoY revenue growth to $163.3M with record QNX segment performance ($80.3M, 87% gross margin). Stock reaction muted (+2%) despite strong beat and Stifel upgrade to $13 target, suggesting catch-up potential over 2-5 days.
providers.risk: Muted market reaction to strong earnings may indicate skepticism about sustainability or broader market headwinds overwhelming the positive catalyst before follow-through occurs.
